verdict.rationale: Fellow ships an official MCP Server (docs and probe confirm it) that lets Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor query meetings—search, transcripts, action items—without writing code, with admin governance controls and access-scoped permissions. missing for 10: explicit confirmation of OAuth-based authentication flow for the MCP connector itself (docs describe API-key auth for the REST API, not the MCP server's auth mechanism) and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
